capabilities: Assign CSS classes to internal links from frontmatter metadata
Handle boolean, string, and array metadata keys
Generate class names like .link-publish-true for use in CSS snippets
extras: The plugin only adds class names; users must write their own CSS snippets to actually style the links. README is short and shows examples but does not cover limits or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to target and style individual internal links according to the metadata of the note they come from.
summary: Adds CSS class names to internal links based on a note's frontmatter metadata so links can be styled with custom CSS snippets.
